title: Cancellation and Resumption Terms, Northgate Rewards and Northgate+
content:
**1. The member's decision.** Cancelling, resuming and choosing immediate cancellation of a Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships membership are the member's own decisions: the agent records the request as a membership request and the member confirms it, and only the confirmed request changes the membership.

**2. Status for a cancellation.** A cancellation, whether at term end or immediate, can be requested only on a membership in active status.

**3. Cancellation at term end.** Where the tier's cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period, a cancellation turns auto-renew off and the membership stays in cancel pending with full benefits until the renewal date, when it closes without a further charge.

**4. Immediate cancellation.** Where the tier allows immediate cancellation the member may instead cancel immediately; on an annual-billed tier any refund is evaluated under the membership fee refund policy, and on Northgate Rewards there is nothing to refund.

**5. Resumption — time gate.** A cancel pending membership can be resumed only before its renewal date. The resume date is compared with the renewal date by calendar date, and a resume on the renewal date itself is too late because the term has already ended; the cut-off lies 0 days before the renewal date. Resuming restores auto-renew with the same renewal date and no new charge.

| Hypothetical renewal date 18 October 2031 | Resume date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| the day before | 17 October 2031 | resumed, same renewal date, no new charge |
| the renewal date itself | 18 October 2031 | too late, the term has ended |

**6. Trials and holds.** A trial is canceled under the free trial rules. A membership in payment hold is not cancelled by request but clears or lapses under the payment hold standard.

**Status table**

| Membership status | Cancellation request possible |
|---|---|
| active | yes, at term end or (where allowed) immediately |
| trial | handled under the free trial rules |
| payment hold | no; it clears or lapses |
| cancel pending | already scheduled; may be resumed before the renewal date |
